T0567.title: RAG
T0567.definition: Retrieval-augmented generation, where a model retrieves external knowledge and uses it as context for generation.
T0567.description: RAG injects retrieved external knowledge into model context, improving timeliness and domain coverage while introducing permission, poisoning, and prompt-injection risks. Governance should cover retrieval scope, document-level permissions, source trust, context filtering, and model-output auditing.
T0567.usageExample: Assess RAG related exposure and define the corresponding controls.

references.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks (Lewis et al., 2020)
